title: 021 · Why? #9: fold y = 2ˣ over y = x and get log₂x; 2³ = 8 flips to log₂8 = 3 (predict-first, white)

captions.instagram:
NDA Maths · Logarithms. Flip y = 2ˣ over the line y = x. You get…? A x² · B log₂x · C 2⁻ˣ 👇

B. Folding over y = x swaps every point: (3, 8) lands on (8, 3).
2³ = 8 becomes log₂8 = 3. A log just runs the power backwards.
And 2ˣ is never 0 or negative, so its flip, log₂x, has no 0 or negative inputs.
Traps: x² mixes up the power of x with the power of 2; 2⁻ˣ is the mirror in the y-axis, not in y = x.

NDA asks logs like this: 2024 (I), Q27. log₄(x − 1) = log₂(x − 3) gives x = 2 or 5, but x = 2 makes x − 3 negative. One solution.
